features.name: cell_uniformity_score
features.description: Average of cell size and shape uniformity, providing a smooth composite feature for linear margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a stable, linearly separable dimension by combining highly correlated uniformity metrics.

features.name: size_shape_discrepancy
features.description: Absolute difference between cell size and shape uniformity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear interactions between size and shape uniformity that a linear SVM might otherwise miss.

features.name: overall_abnormality_index
features.description: Unweighted average of all nine cytological characteristics.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a strong, continuous severity measure that acts as a primary axis for linear separation.
features.formula: (Clump_Thickness + Cell_Size_Uniformity + Cell_Shape_Uniformity + Marginal_Adhesion + Single_Epi_Cell_Size + Bare_Nuclei + Bland_Chromatin + Normal_Nucleoli + Mitoses) / 9.0

features.name: nuclear_severity_composite
features.description: Average of nuclear-specific features: Bare Nuclei, Normal Nucleoli, and Bland Chromatin.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates nuclear abnormalities into a single continuous feature, improving margin clarity for the SVM.

features.name: mitosis_to_thickness_ratio
features.description: Ratio of mitoses to clump thickness, smoothed by adding 1 to the denominator.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights cases with disproportionately high mitotic activity relative to clump thickness.

features.name: adhesion_to_size_ratio
features.description: Ratio of marginal adhesion to cell size uniformity, smoothed by adding 1 to the denominator.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes the relationship between cell adhesion loss and size irregularity as a continuous feature.

features.name: max_cell_irregularity
features.description: The maximum value between cell size uniformity and cell shape uniformity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures that the most severe uniformity metric drives the linear decision boundary.

features.name: log_bare_nuclei
features.description: Log-transformed bare nuclei score to reduce the impact of extreme values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the distribution of bare nuclei, making it more suitable for linear SVM weights.

features.name: clump_thickness_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of clump thickness from its training set mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures abnormal clump thickness in either direction as a positive magnitude.

features.name: high_severity_feature_count
features.description: Count of key features (Clump Thickness, Cell Size Uniformity, Bare Nuclei) exceeding typical normal thresholds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a robust, step-wise severity indicator that complements continuous features.

features.name: semantic_cellular_abnormality_risk
features.description: Assesses the overall risk of severe cellular abnormality based on the combination of cell characteristics, providing a continuous risk score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex, non-linear expert judgments about cell morphology that simple formulas might miss.

features.name: semantic_proliferation_potential
features.description: Assesses the potential for rapid cell division and tissue invasion based on Mitoses, Single Epithelial Cell Size, and Clump Thickness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic evaluation of growth potential, offering a distinct semantic axis for the SVM.
